summary: Verified petugas QR scanner bug-fix. Scanner opens cleanly from new 'Pindai QR warga' button above manual input, overlay mounts without crashing the petugas page, and close button returns to the petugas screen without errors. Manual lookup of PLH-0503-0127 returns Bu Ratna; full weigh flow (steppers, clean bonus, total compute, save -> toast, next-warga reset) works end-to-end. Warga Jemput page renders a real scannable QR SVG (data-testid member-qr contains <svg>) encoding member_code PLH-0503-0127. Petugas login (081200000001/123456) and warga login (081200000002/123456) both succeed.
critical_code_review_comments: QrScanner.jsx: in headless/mocked camera envs html5-qrcode may initialize without error and never fire decode; a 'Masukkan manual' fallback is only shown on camera error. Consider also showing a 'Masukkan manual' / 'Tutup' affordance in the normal (non-error) state (currently only an X close button exists, which is sufficient but less discoverable).
Jemput.jsx: _unusedQrGrid() dead-code helper should be removed.
Petugas.jsx: find() uses stale `code` state when called from scan (works because we pass text argument explicitly), but relying on parameter is correct — no action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Petugas scanner bug fix verified: open-scanner-button (above manual input) opens qr-scanner-overlay with camera region; qr-scanner-close returns to page without crash. Headless Chromium does not provide a real QR to decode so onResult path is not exercised live, but code path (setCode + find(text)) is covered by the manual find flow which works. Warga member-qr renders QRCodeSVG successfully.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: petugas had no camera scanner, only manual input + decorative QR on warga side. Fix added html5-qrcode-based QrScanner.jsx mounted conditionally via scanning state in Petugas.jsx, and replaced decorative grid with QRCodeSVG in Jemput.jsx MemberQr. All data-testids present and wired correctly.
